name: Meridian Zeppelin — Executive Class
description: If cargo zeppelins are beautiful, executive zeppelins are breathtaking. Smaller than their industrial cousins, these airships serve as flying boardrooms, party venues, and private retreats for the corporate elite. Mahogany and chrome interiors, panoramic observation decks, private staterooms, and staff quarters for a crew that includes a chef, a bartender, and a security detail. They drift above the city like floating mansions, visible from every district — permanent reminders that some people live in the sky.
cost: Φ5,000,000 purchase. Φ50,000/month operating cost. Charter: Φ10,000/hour.
armament: Point defense systems, signal jamming, emergency descent flares.
common_usage: Corporate entertaining, private travel, mobile conference venue, showing off.
story_hooks: An executive zeppelin hosts a party where a murder occurs 2,000 meters above the city — locked-room mystery in the sky
A zeppelin has been circling the same district for three days and no one answers hails — something is wrong up there
